RBI Mandates Monthly Disclosure of Bank Loan Rates

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new disclosure norms requiring all lenders to reveal their interest rates on loans every month. This move aims to bring greater transparency in lending practices. The draft directions, unveiled by the RBI, apply to all types of lenders and will necessitate monthly publication of loan rate information. This change is expected to provide borrowers with clearer insights into the cost of credit.
